title: Austin's 1987-88 Budget Work Session
summary:
*   City leaders convened a special meeting dedicated exclusively to a worksession on the upcoming 1987-88 fiscal year budget.
*   All council members were present for the two-hour discussion, held at the Central Library.
*   The meeting focused solely on budget planning, with no other agenda items or policy decisions made.
transcript:
Austin City Council
MINUTES
For
SPECIAL CALLED MEETING - June 03, 1987 - 3:00 P.M.
4TH FLOOR AUDITORIUM - CENTRAL LIBRARY
Council Chamber. 307 VNfest Second Street. Austin, Texas Memorandum To: Mayor Cooksey
called to order the special called meeting of the Council, noting the presence of all
Councilmembers.
Mayor Cooksey announced the purpose of the meeting was to hold a worksession on discussion
of the 1987/88 Budget Work Plan, which they did.
Council adjourned its special called meeting at 5:00 p.m.
